_about: How the email lens reads a footprint's mail records. For each registered domain it reads the mail servers (dns.json mail_rr_types), the SPF policy (a TXT record of the domain starting with spf_prefix, RFC 7208), the DMARC policy (a TXT record of the dmarc_label name below the domain starting with dmarc_prefix, RFC 7489) and the DKIM keys stored for names below the dkim_label name (RFC 6376). SPF ending in one of permissive_all lets anyone send as the domain; softfail_all only marks such mail. A DMARC policy in monitor_policies asks receivers to deliver spoofed mail anyway. A domain that receives no mail should still publish an SPF policy of none_spf and a DMARC policy of reject so that it cannot be spoofed. Records are only as complete as the enumeration: a DMARC name that was never queried reads as none stored. Add values here, not in Go code.
